Federal Budget Deficit and Debt

outlays more than offset rising receipts.  Outlays rose by $617 billion to $6.75 trillion (23.4% of 
GDP) in FY 2024, partly reflecting increased net interest payments on the federal debt, a sharp 
drop in proprietary receipts by the Department of Education, and higher spending on Social
